name: Peninsula Gardens Live Rosin Disposable | Plan Z
description: A Rainbow Beltz 2.0 pheno. Bred by Archive and hunted by @monopolymeltz. Z terps for days. Bright green flowers that like most Zkittlez crosses aren't the prettiest but make up for it in flavor. A nice mellow high that also is an amazing hasher.
